purpose: Explain why a content region has no usable records and provide host-owned recovery actions appropriate to that condition.
behaviorProvider: Native section, heading and paragraph semantics; host supplies all action controls.

host: real recovery actions and async lifecycle

requirements.statement: no-results defaults to filter recovery copy, no-data to first-record/source copy, and error to failed-loading/retry copy. The default preset is no-results; compact changes presentation rather than condition semantics.
Choose the preset matching the actual condition: no matches, no stored data or failed retrieval. Do not present an error or pending fetch as a successful empty result.

Use nullish fallback for icon, title and description. null or undefined selects preset content; an empty string can deliberately produce empty title/description and must not be assumed to restore the default.

Generate ids for the h3 and description paragraph and reference them with aria-labelledby and aria-describedby on the section. Explicit root props can override these defaults and the host must preserve valid associations.
Wrap the displayed icon in aria-hidden=true so the title and description convey the condition. The icon is not an independent interactive control.
Supply functional, named action and secondaryAction controls for clearing filters, adding data, retrying or another real recovery path. EmptyState invokes no retry, navigation or mutation itself.
Render the action row only when action or secondaryAction is truthy, in primary-then-secondary order, and render children after the action region.

Own pending/disabled/success/error transitions and appropriate button types in supplied actions, especially inside forms. EmptyState provides no submission handling, loading state or automatic focus handoff.
Account for the fixed h3 in the surrounding heading hierarchy and decide whether changing content needs a live announcement. The section is not an alert or live region by default.
Use feedback group tokens for the empty-state icon, typography and layout while shared action components retain their owning groups. Keep semantic feedback distinct from decorative surfaces.

limitations: This component does not detect empty/error conditions, fetch data, retry, or announce changes automatically.
The heading is fixed at h3; no headingLevel option is currently exposed.
Arbitrary root props and ReactNode content can override or undermine the default associations, so host composition still needs review.
